methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to represent the total number of initial injury-related visits each year in the United States
estimates were adjusted for hospital nonresponse and changes in the number of ED visits from year to year
95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using statistical software that accounted for the sample weights and the complex sampling design
Estimates based on <20 cases or with coefficients of variation >30% were considered unstable, and the rates and CIs are not reported.
P-values of ≤0.05 were considered statistically significant.
